title: Budget

yearView.hint: Switch the view to "Month" to manage the limits for a specific month.

copiedNotice: The previous month's budget has been copied. Adjust the amounts you need by tapping each limit.

fixedExpenses.title: Fixed expenses
fixedExpenses.item1: When you enter a month, active ones are automatically created as transactions with the day and category you set for them.
fixedExpenses.item2: If you add one today, it's generated instantly also in the month you're viewing, even if the day has already passed.
fixedExpenses.item3: Deactivating pauses without deleting: it stops generating in future months, but past transactions remain.
fixedExpenses.item4: Editing (amount, day…) only affects future months not yet generated. To adjust a specific month's one, edit the transaction directly.
fixedExpenses.item5: Deleting the fixed expense removes future transactions that haven't occurred yet. Past ones are kept so history isn't distorted.

fixedIncome.title: Fixed income
fixedIncome.hint: Same as fixed expenses, but positive: salary, rent you collect, a monthly fee… They're materialized automatically every month and counted as income in the statistics.

byCategory.title: Budgets by category
byCategory.emptyTitle: You haven't set any budgets yet.
byCategory.emptyHint: Tap "No limit" on any category to set one.
byCategory.item1: Each budget lives in a specific month. If in March you raise the Food one to €500, April keeps its own value — they don't all change at once.
byCategory.item2: When you enter a new month with no budgets, we copy the previous month's only once so you don't start from scratch every time.
byCategory.item3: Click the limit amount to edit it. Set it to 0 to remove the budget for that category that month.
byCategory.item4: The spending that counts is filtered by the transaction's actual date (occurred_on), not when you logged it.
byCategory.item5: Bar states: up to 70% green, 70-90% orange, from 90% red.
